//: Debezium outbox event router (technical design 5.3, spec 11).
The bundled stack publishes cx_outbox with the in-process relay, which keeps the
single image self-contained. This connector is the production alternative: it reads
the WAL instead of polling, so publication survives an application outage and adds
Register it against a Kafka Connect cluster:
Then set CX_OutboxRelay__Enabled=false so the two do not both publish.
name: cx-outbox-connector

config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: cx_outbox_slot
config.publication.name: cx_outbox_publication
config.//route: aggregate_type is cx_event, so every row routes to cx.persisted.events.v1
config.//headers: aggregate_id travels as a header for tracing and replay tooling
config.//dlq: an unroutable change goes to a dead letter topic instead of stalling the connector
config.errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name: cx.persistence.dlq.v1
